THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.M. POONACHA  ORAL JUDGMENT

This Court, vide order dated 30.10.2023 recorded the request made by the learned counsel for the appellant for grant of two weeks time to bring the legal representatives on record and further ordered for listing of the appeal as a final chance after two weeks, and also observed that if the NC:
2025:KHC:24675 HC-KAR application is not filed, the appeals will be dismissed on that ground.
2. Till date, the application to bring the legal representatives of the deceased appellant has not been filed.
In view of the order dated 13.10.2023, the above appeal is dismissed as having abated.
